heading: INT. SUBMERGED BELL TOWER - UNDERWATER CHAPEL - NIGHT

units.text: INT. SUBMERGED BELL TOWER - UNDERWATER CHAPEL - NIGHT
Green light through drowned stained glass.
Air pockets shiver beneath the vaulted ceiling.
A rope ladder hangs into the dark.
KESTREL VANE, 30s, hooded, perches on a pew back, a lantern of glowing moss in her lap.
Four figures wade in from the nave.
MORWENNA ASH, 50s, the Reeve, wears the keys of a dead town on her belt.
Behind her, OLD CINDER, 70s, leans on a staff of coral.
HOLLIS PRYCE, 20s, shield-bearer, carries nothing.
And the STRANGER, hooded, no age, walks in last and drips nothing.
You're late.
units.name: MORWENNA

units.text: Tide's late.
units.name: KESTREL

units.text: Cinder lowers himself onto a pew.
Hollis stays standing, jaw working.
Is this the place where the oath was broken?
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Depends who's asking.
units.name: KESTREL

units.text: The Stranger crosses to the altar.
A single bell rope hangs there, wet and green.
He lifts a hand toward it.
Hollis steps in his path.
Don't.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: You flinch like a man who has already rung it.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Hollis says nothing.
His hand drifts to the empty place where a sword should be.
Let him, Hollis.
units.name: CINDER

units.text: Cinder --
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: Let. Him.
units.name: CINDER

units.text: Hollis steps aside.
The Stranger takes the rope.
He does not pull.
You were named at the drowning. I remember your face.
units.name: MORWENNA

units.text: Then you remember I was kind to you.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Morwenna's hand closes around her keys until her knuckles go white.
Say your name, and I'll let you ring it.
units.name: KESTREL

units.text: The Stranger lowers his hood.
A lean face, old scars like river-maps.
He smiles at her the way one smiles at a debt.
Ambrose Thale.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: Good.
units.name: KESTREL

units.text: And now you must all stand very still.
units.name: AMBROSE

units.text: He pulls the rope.
No sound.
The water in the nave goes flat as glass.
Every flame in the room leans toward the bell, and then, together, all of them go out, and in the dark Hollis exhales for the first time in a year.
A long beat.
A single drip, somewhere.
Cinder laughs, soft and cracked.
Well. That's that.
units.name: CINDER

units.text: Kestrel relights the lantern.
Morwenna is already unbuckling her keys.
